change: Accounting payload format unchanged from 1.0.5. Adds explicit data-format.json registration, SQLite user_version=1, verified backups and compatibility checks. Automatically registers older v1/v2 data as v3.
backup: Before in-place registration, copy and verify the original data. Imports preserve the original folder.
downgrade: Pre-1.0.6 apps cannot enforce version checks. Use a compatible complete pre-upgrade backup before downgrading. Pre-1.0.4 apps do not implement Ignored tags; pre-1.0.5 apps do not implement borrowing groups.
